body.message:
Please note that your previous booking was confirmed on a month-by-month basis, which did not require advance payment for future months.

However, if you would like to secure and guarantee the same rates for the upcoming 3 months, the current requirement is to pay the first month’s rent and 50% of the last month’s rent in advance.

Alternatively, we can assist with a month-by-month extension, but we will not be able to guarantee the same rates for the next 3 months, as rates are subject to market conditions and availability.

We apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your understanding.

Thank you.
